oracle_provenance.method: Independent arithmetic only; no production evaluator/process used. Nodal phasors, special-angle Fourier integration, band endpoints, LC resonance, and Hertzian current moment derive non-default oracles.
oracle_provenance.source_limits: Primary references inherited from research, not independently re-fetched by tester. Models are engineering estimates, not hardware validation.
oracle_provenance.tolerances: Rust 1e-12 relative with zero absolute floor; process 1e-11. Only trigonometric analytic null uses 8*epsilon*Ipk and load-scaled absolute roundoff limits.

verification.detail: No build, tests, lint, formatter, production process, native launch or screenshot inspection. Independent Python arithmetic used only to derive numerical scenario values. Main must execute all authored checks.

untested_gaps: Compilation and Rust execution remain Main-owned.
Actual JSON-lines recovery and six-model native UI journeys remain Main-owned.
Desktop images are V2EmcRun-owned; tester makes no pixel approval claim.
Three source-derived regressions remain unexecuted and require Main disposition.
Physical enclosure, receiver, converter, snubber and cable calibration remain outside ideal-model assertions.

suspected_defects.finding: Representable logarithmic shielding is rejected because wavelength/(2*slot_length) overflows.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Compute shielding in the log domain without the overflowing quotient.
suspected_defects.evidence: Independent source/arithmetic analysis only; failing success assertion authored, not executed.

suspected_defects.finding: cable_length/distance underflows to zero before multiplication; finite nonzero electric field is silently lost.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Use range-safe current-length/frequency/distance product ordering; preserve representable final fields.
suspected_defects.evidence: Independent source/arithmetic analysis; counterpart V2EmcRun found another decisive vector. Failing strict relative assertion authored, not executed.

suspected_defects.finding: Squaring positive reciprocal underflows Lp to zero; Rs then becomes zero and all finite-output checks accept false component values.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Reject zero-underflow of physically positive identified components without arbitrary practical input bounds.
suspected_defects.evidence: Source/arithmetic analysis only. Research emc.md:242,292 requires explicit arithmetic failure. Failing rejection assertion authored, not executed.

parent_desktop_scenarios: For every owned ID, enter the independent non-default success vector and check every output against this receipt; inspect units and captions.
Slot: enter width=length and then correct; confirm stale results clear. Exercise t=0 and L=lambda/20.
RC: switch Cd between zero and 1e-9, then balance unequal R/C time constants; preserve zero conversion and signed mismatch.
Harmonic: display triangle/full-edge equality, analytic even-order null and fractional-order rejection; then restore valid non-default vector.
Dither: enter fs=275999,276000,276001 with remaining DITHER inputs; show negative/zero/positive gap without invalidating overlap.
Snubber: equalize measured frequencies for error, then recover. Display zero swing and near-equal frequency result without claiming exact damping.
Cable: reject kr<10, recover; zero common-mode current remains valid. Show tiny nonzero field without rounding it into a false exact zero.
